method: Normalised (whitespace-collapsed) line hashing against the pinned upstream source trees. Only lines of 25 or more characters are indexed, to avoid trivial matches. A match is reported when 3 or more consecutive lines of a tracked file appear verbatim in an upstream.

coverage.skip_rule: Directories whose files are bulk measurement/evidence payloads are not scanned for verbatim upstream blocks; they are inventoried and classified but not content-compared. This is a stated coverage limit.

limitations: This whitespace-line scan does not detect translated formulas, reformatted tables or semantic provenance. Separately,40 matching altitude/density anchors were confirmed in public code; see boundary-independent-review.md.
